description: Final per-variant scores: surface expression, 15-ligand saturating-concentration effects with SE and LFSR, three-parameter Hill parameters (Emin/logEC50/Emax) for morphine, fentanyl and DAMGO, operational-model parameters, variant-level PCA scores, and external annotation.
Rescaled per-concentration scores and SDs for the three concentration-response screens, one column pair per ligand and concentration, plus the ligand-free (forskolin-only) arm of the DAMGO screen.

Position-level aggregates: mean missense effect per ligand, mean surface expression, mean Hill EC50/Emax per DRC ligand, position- and variant-level PCA scores, morphine-vs-fentanyl LOF bias, and G protein contact class.

grain: one row per position x ligand
description: Fraction of missense variants at each position scoring as loss- or gain-of-function for each ligand, with the synonymous-derived thresholds used.

Ligand-level reference: chemotype, efficacy class, which screens it entered, wild-type pooled-cAMP and TRUPATH Gi1 logEC50 and Emax with SEM and n, and PCA ligand loadings from both the position- and variant-level fits.

grain: one row per position x ligand
description: Structural contact assignment: closest heavy-atom and side-chain distance from each receptor position to each ligand, the shell call (first / second), and the source structure.

grain: one row per variant x ligand (fitted curve)
description: Fitted TRUPATH Gi1 BRET parameters for all low-throughput validation pharmacology: the single mutants behind figure 7d-f and the A119L double-mutant series behind figures 8d/f/g and S11a. The pipeline column distinguishes the two normalisations.
Per-sample screening metadata: assay, date, replicate, ligand and concentration, sort bin, mean/median sequencing coverage and number of variants observed.

grain: one row per individual replicate point
description: Every individual point behind sheet 07, with raw BRET and the normalised value, across both the singles and doubles pipelines.
